sentences.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
sentences.zh: 犹豫了一会儿后，他把书放在了桌上。

sentences.en: He had no hesitation about killing the bird for food.
sentences.zh: 他毫不犹豫地为了食物杀死了那只鸟。

sentences.en: Without hesitation, we set to asking riddles and telling tales.
sentences.zh: 我们毫不犹豫地开始猜谜和讲故事。

senses.zh: 犹豫, 踌躇, 不愿犹豫(之事或行为)
